caption: The drawing depicts a group of people in historical or traditional attire, arranged in a horizontal procession. At the center, a male figure with a bare upper body, red head covering, red shorts, and green pants is carrying a large wooden cross on his shoulder. Surrounding him are several men dressed in red jackets with gold trim, blue pants, and tall, colorful hats adorned with patterns of blue, red, and white. One man on the left is holding a white spear and wears black shoes, while another is shown leading a black horse decorated with a red and white mask or harness. A woman wearing a brown dress and white head covering is kneeling beside the cross, reaching towards the central figure. In the background, more men in similar uniforms and hats hold long spears. The scene takes place in front of a wall with arches and niches, painted in shades of light brown and gray. The overall color palette includes reds, blues, browns, and light skin tones. The composition is densely packed, with figures overlapping and filling most of the space.
title: Station of the Cross No. 2: "The Cross is Laid on Jesus"
